app: VacuumNav (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose - RN checklist adapted to Compose sources)
scoreNotes: Run-2 close-out: all 16 findings fixed across both runs. Static regression greps clean (emoji 0, visible em-dash 0, inline hex 0, raw sp/fontSize 0, manual back 0, off-scale gaps 0, broken interpolations 0, Text(+) 0, destructive actions all confirmed). Design mean 4.0 -> A; slop A (no tell-mapped findings open). Live checks still pending a device - see unverified.

findings.summary: Three competing accents (teal #0B7A6A, blue CTAs, green status #7BE0B0) and 35 inline hex literals across screen files; no semantic color token layer beyond Theme.kt's scheme
Android/gesture back from sub-screens (Maps, History, Diagnostics) exits the app - no BackHandler pops to Home; nav mechanical check fails
'Welcome home!' greeting as the primary Home header; personalization is not the product
Manual '‹ Back' text buttons (x3) instead of a TopAppBar with navigation icon; no header owner on sub-screens
Link ERROR_LINK exists in code but no UI banner; loading is plain text with no skeleton; no standard empty/error treatment
No type scale or spacing rhythm: raw sp values (11..32) and ad-hoc dp scattered per screen
Radius drift: 14/16/20/24/28/50 in active use with no shape lock
Emoji as icons/controls remain in13 places (transport chip, mode chips, dock buttons, save, warnings) after the nav bar migrated to Material icons
Map screen opens with a stat-triplet header; metrics are real (area/times/time) so triage = restyle under tokens, keep the numbers
Em-dashes in visible strings ('Stuck — gave up', 'Robot stopped — E-STOP') against the copy rules
Diagnostics stale-age strings are broken interpolations: '-e s ago (stale)' and ' ms ago (stale)' render garbage (missing values)
Home status pill hardcodes 'SIM - IDLE' regardless of actual transport/state (says SIM even on Wi-Fi/BT link)
HomeScreen has no scroll container (fixed Column + weight spacer): clips on small screens and at 1.3x font
Destructive actions fire with no confirmation: History 'Clear', Maps 'Delete', Zones 'Clear all'
10 gap/padding values off the Sp rhythm scale (20/10/6/72 dp) despite Tokens.kt declaring Sp the only padding scale
Schedules FAB renders Text('+') instead of Icons.Filled.Add (used elsewhere) - glyph icon breaks the one-family rule

signaturesToPreserve: bottom tab order (5 tabs, existing icons)
unverified: no device/adb this run: dark mode live pass, 1.3x font scale, IME/keyboard
Trunk Test for interior screens is code-reconstructed, not cold-dropped
